generated_from: the works register and the study register of the La Flèche pages, as the pages display them
description: Public registers of the La Flèche pages of the Historical Libraries Project: works, their witnesses, studies, comparisons with Hume, open questions in the project's records, and the coverage counts. Each value is shown as the site's pages show it. The texts the pages name are working machine-read texts produced by optical character recognition; they have not been verified against the page images and are not editions. The coverage counts of 'How the numbers fit together', with their terms. These pages record textual relations that may warrant historical investigation. They are not evidence that Hume read, used, borrowed from, recalled or replied to any of these books. To cite the site, see the About / Citation page.

fields.label: what is counted
fields.definition: the definition of the term, where the block gives one
fields.also: the further counts the block gives

rows.label: catalogue entries
rows.definition: One entry of the library's catalogue as transcribed by the project.
also: 2,092 have a candidate digital copy found by automated search, 934 of them matched with confidence. A digital copy found by automated search is a candidate match, not a verified identification of the catalogue copy.
The entries stand under 22 section headings. Section headings are counted as transcribed; a few are spelling variants of one another.

rows.label: indexed works
rows.definition: A work the project selected from the catalogue for processing, or a contextual text studied beside it; every indexed work is listed in the works index.
also: 101 are works recorded in the catalogue and 3 are contextual texts.

rows.label: works with a page
rows.definition: Given to every indexed work that has a machine-read text or a recorded activity; the other indexed works were selected and not yet processed, and the index gives the recorded reason for each.

rows.label: works with a processed text
rows.definition: One machine-read text made from one scan; a work can have several (volumes, or an earlier and a later ingestion), and only current ones are counted.

rows.label: works screened
rows.definition: The first screening against Hume's texts was run on the work.

rows.label: works studied closely
rows.definition: Comparisons with Hume are held, or the work has been audited or made the subject of a campaign.

rows.label: works with a published text
rows.definition: A working machine-read text that can be read on this site.
also: 19 have working texts published in the present format, 22 texts and 117,088 paragraphs in all; the others are source previews approved earlier.
